verdict.rationale: Devin exposes a general-purpose API for creating sessions programmatically and automating workflows (devin-docs-8, devin-docs-9), which could technically be invoked from a CI/CD pipeline to trigger a fix, but there is no explicit documentation of a CI/CD integration, GitHub Actions/Jenkins plugin, or a documented pattern for auto-triggering on failed builds/tests. missing for 10: explicit CI/CD pipeline integration docs, a build-failure/test-failure trigger example, and independent evidence of this workflow being used in practice.
